title: Quality Studio usage ledger entry v4
description: One agent-backed review operation. Version 4 counts every input token in tokens.inputTokens, including cache reads (cachedInputTokens) and cache writes (cacheWriteInputTokens, Claude's cache_creation_input_tokens), so caps and costs see all billed input. Readers normalize earlier Claude entries, whose inputTokens held fresh input only and which never recorded cache writes, and flag them as under-priced (for example the 2026-09-28 agent-studio-dev sweep).

runId.description: Provider or CLI run identifier for this individual review operation.

model.description: The model id the CLI was asked to run. The literal "runner-default" appears only together with modelSource "runner-default".

reviewRunId.description: Durable sweep/job identifier shared by every operation in one review run. Absent for standalone CLI reviews.

modelSource.description: explicit: the caller named the model. policy-default: no model was named and Quality Studio resolved the synchronized routing policy's route for the CLI and passed it explicitly. runner-default: no model was named and the policy routes nothing for the CLI, so the CLI's own default served the run and is unknown.

cost.description: Estimated provider cost at the catalog price valid at the operation timestamp. total is null when no price resolved; status names the reason (resolved, unknownModel, noPriceForDate).

inputTokens.description: All input tokens the model processed: fresh input plus cache reads plus cache writes.

cachedInputTokens.description: Cache-read (cache-hit) input tokens; a subset of inputTokens.

cacheWriteInputTokens.description: Cache-write (cache-creation) input tokens; a subset of inputTokens. Absent when the CLI bills no cache writes (Codex, Gemini).
